parts.text: $FCX: copper cathode drove 197% of the revenue increase, pushing Q3 sales to $7.5B (+8% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #mining
$PSNH: revenue fell 8% to $3.0B in Q3, backed by a 21.1% operating margin as costs dropped alongside sales. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$YUM: profit is growing faster than sales — operating profit +248% vs revenue +4%. Q3 2026 revenue $2.1B, net earnings $1.6B. 👇 #earnings #restaurants
$MBC: growth sped up to +48% from +12%, but costs rose faster and left a net loss of $9M on $1.0B of revenue. Q3 operating margin 1.0%. 👇 #earnings #consumer
$FNF: revenue growth slowed to −11% to $3.6B, but net earnings jumped 77% to $633M on lower costs. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$BX: revenue growth slowed to −1% from +36% the quarter before. Q3 revenue $3.1B. 👇 #earnings #finance
$MRNA: revenue growth sped up to +29% in Q3, reaching $1.3B with a 9.9% operating margin. Net earnings came in at $162M. 👇 #earnings #biotech
$ARES: sold more but kept less — revenue +9% to $1.3B, but operating profit fell 72%. Costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #finance
$BSTT: revenue down 8% to $1.8B in Q3 2026, while operating profit reached $1.5B with an 81.8% margin. Net loss narrowed to $296M. 👇 #earnings #REITs
$VIRT: profit grew faster than sales — revenue +40% to $1.2B, operating profit +84%. Q3 margin reached 28.7%. 👇 #earnings #finance
$FG: about 83¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit. Q3 revenue $1.1B, down 33% Y/Y. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$AKAM: sold more but kept less — revenue +6% to $1.1B, operating profit −35% as costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #industrials
